reply_text: @Bettina Kroll: The official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your cutover recap from 2025-12-08 gives the same official date. Your recap also says you kept running the account day to day until November 21, and Kwame fully took over on **November 22, 2025**. For the tracker, I'd use 2025-11-03 as the handoff date and note 2025-11-22 as the day-to-day takeover. I replied in this thread.
